notes: Goal controls on mobile: the chat shows a GOAL banner (phase, objective, round budget, blocked reason) with one-tap Resume for paused goals. Host bridge GET /sessions/{id}/goal and POST /sessions/{id}/goal/resume use DSH ctx.goals for the live agent, so you can see and re-arm a paused goal from Android without the desktop UI. Also cancelable uploads with progress and the 0.2.77 streaming upload OOM fix.
